subject: Taxes
title: Standard vs. Itemized Deductions
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Standard vs. Itemized Deductions.

hook.text: Every taxpayer chooses: take the standard deduction or add up individual expenses.

buildup.text: The 2024 standard deduction is $14,600 for singles and $29,200 for married couples. You subtract this from gross income.

discovery.text: Itemizing means listing specific expenses: mortgage interest, state taxes, charitable donations.

twist.text: Before 2018, about 30% itemized. The Tax Cuts and Jobs Act nearly doubled the standard deduction.

climax.text: The standard deduction is the government's way of simplifying taxes. One number replaces hundreds of receipts.

punchline.text: One number or a box of receipts. 90% choose the one number.

quiz.question: What percentage of US taxpayers take the standard deduction?
